## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] The component uses theme tokens only (no hardcoded colors)
- [ ] It accepts a `className` prop and works at phone width
- [ ] I tried it with the keyboard and checked focus states
- [ ] I added or updated the entry in `registry.json` and the preview in `registry/demos.tsx`
- [ ] I ran `npm run registry:build` and committed the changes in `public/r/`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and `npm run build` pass
